title: MAINT: WP11_PIV_ERR_SW conflates transport truncation with card status error
description: All PIV and OpenPGP functions return WP11_PIV_ERR_SW (or WP11_OPENPGP_ERR_SW) for both 'card returned unexpected status word' and 'response was too short to contain a status word'. A caller cannot distinguish transport corruption from a legitimate card error. Fix: add WP11_PIV_ERR_TRUNCATED and WP11_OPENPGP_ERR_TRUNCATED error codes, used when resplen < 2. Update the public headers and the response-length checks in all six affected functions. Document the distinction in the header.
